selection.p64: Widened by P64 towards thirty threats and thirty calm scenes on foot, preferring onsets that start from calm. 109 fight beginnings in 22 labelled recordings (first aim, fire or melee after ten seconds without one) were the starting point; almost all of them begin with red already on the map, so the threat onsets were searched as the first red marker or lit star after at least two calm seconds on foot (calm may run through a cutscene or black screen). 88 proposals after six calm seconds and 99 enemy and star proposals after two were refined on native frames and looked at. Kept: 17 new enemy onsets and 4 new star onsets, 26 new calm windows.

dropped_from_p62.hit-01: False onset: the green end of the health bar stays at the same column (pixel measure, 1 s before to 1.5 s after); the HUD reader took the N icon sliding over the bar for a fall. The frame is a camera cut; no red marker follows.
dropped_from_p62.hit-02: False onset: the health bar keeps its length (0.8 before and 0.8 half a second after); the N icon slides over its end.
dropped_from_p62.hit-03: False onset: the health bar stays full; the bright sand behind the transparent bar made the HUD reader read a fall.
dropped_from_p62.wanted-01: In a vehicle: the scene set holds scenes on foot until vehicles have an answer set of their own.

selection.hits: No health fall that starts from calm was confirmed. Of 61 label proposals for a fall on foot after six calm seconds, 41 got a native onset; the pixel measure of the bar's green end and the magnified bars show no lasting fall in any of them, or an icon covers the bar's end so that a fall cannot be told within two frames. The HUD reader reads a fall whenever a map icon (N, a flag, a question mark, a car) slides over the bar's end, and on damaged frames.

selection.limitation: Below thirty threats: the recordings hold few threats that start from calm on foot, no confirmed health fall from calm, and only six star onsets on foot. More would need footage of Kerim on foot meeting enemies and the police without a mission cutscene before, and being shot at from calm.
